name: Rhythm-Maker's Drum, +3

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Regain Bardic Inspiration
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration.

summary: +3 to your Bard spell attacks and save DC; once a day, regain a use of Bardic Inspiration.
text: While you hold this drum, your Bard spells gain +3 to their spell attack rolls and saving throw DCs. Once per dawn, you can also play it as a Magic action to regain a spent use of your Bardic Inspiration.
